_doc: Door / garage-door objects per MP map: what the editor draws (baked leaves of the SP render paks) vs what the game has.

kind baked = prop instance in <level>.pak (matrix at pak offset; world center/size in m); process = spawner of <level>-ingame.pak (AnalogDoor / DoorwayProcess / SimpleObject door actor), NOT drawn by the editor.

in_game: removed (a level edit hid it; the editor geometry already applies it), closed (baked leaf with solid collision), no-collision (baked leaf is drawn but nothing blocks: passable), present (process door spawns in the match, initial state closed/idle), parked (spawner parked below the map), unknown.

editor_action: none everywhere - no door pose could be extracted and nothing proves a baked leaf is hidden/posed in game (re/door-states-1102.md). 'verify' = a baked leaf and a process door sit in the same doorway: check in game which one the player sees.
p1-bookstore: Part I conversion, no TLOU2 door props / spawners (empty list).
Generated 11-02 by an offline scan (level_edit.find_instances + Havok collision inside the leaf box + spawner dumps of the -ingame paks).
